$comment: Catalog operations the SDK deliberately does not expose, each with a reason.
The coverage check (npm run coverage) requires every Zero query and mutator to be
either referenced by a registry or listed here. A new backend operation therefore
fails the check until someone decides what to do with it.
Reason grammar: superseded-by:<name> | legacy-unused | internal | deferred:<why>
